本捕房通常有六名华籍侦探巡佐和一名华籍侦探警长，在扣除日间和夜间捕房勤务后，剩下四名华籍侦探巡佐和一名华籍侦探警长用于巡逻和调查工作。目前一名华籍侦探巡佐休短假，一名被暂停常规勤务，剩下两名华籍侦探巡佐和该名华籍侦探警长用于外勤工作。巡逻工作在上午8时至晚上10时之间进行，除非个别侦探有案件需出庭，或在某案件中进行调查，或因其他警务原因替代理行捕房勤务的人员。除巡逻和捕房勤务外，巡逻人员还需就被盗财物进行调查，有时还需对在个别侦探执行捕房勤务期间发生的案件进行进一步调查，以及就逮捕令、传票、接到其他捕房关于犯罪的电话消息后在当地医院的动向等进行调查。

以上是常规日常工作，但在发生武装抢劫、看守或恐吓信案件调查，或任何需要捕房勤务人员协助的情况下，所有侦探无论白天黑夜均被召集，独立于他们当天或当晚已有或需履行的任何职责。

捕房日间勤务时间为上午8时至晚上10时，夜间勤务时间为晚上10时至次日上午8时。

除非被派往进行特定调查，否则侦探不走访除茶馆以外的持牌场所，此规定同样适用于赌馆，上述场所均未获得工部局许可，均属无牌经营场所（P.P.L.）。

C. I. D. WORK AT HONGKEW STATION

Sir,

Reference to the attached I must first point out
that we have 7 Foreign, 5 Japanese and 10 Chinese
Detectives attached to Hongkew C. I. D.

The District is divided into 12 Sections, and one
C. D. C. is appointed to each Section for general
observation. Of the remainder of the C. D. C's. three
men do Station Duty from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m., and two
Night Duty 10 p.m. to 6 a.m. Special patrols are
appointed and sent out from time to time to deal with
any particular outbreak of specified crime and the
Sub-Inspector and Sergeants supervise and assist the
C. D. C's. in their work in general.

Licensed premises Clubs, Hotels, Bars and such
places are visited and kept under surveillance by members
of the Uniform branch, but whenever free from other
duties our Foreign Detectives, and Chinese visit these
places and keep them under surveillance. Second-hand
shops and pawnshops are visited from time to time and
kept under close surveillance by our Foreign and Chinese
Detectives, and we have one Chinese Detective especially
detailed to keep daily watch on pawnshops and Second-hand
Shops where chiefly Foreign goods are pawned or disposed
of.

The Japanese Detectives besides attending to their
ordinary duties are instructed to keep surveillance over
all Japanese Licensed premises, Second-hand Shops and
pawnshops.
